messages:
sam_sales: Heads-up — FinFlow POC kickoff tomorrow. They require Dedicated pool + VPC peering and want audit log streaming to their Splunk HEC (can't accept our hosted S3). Also asked for KMS-backed exports and per-request request_id in logs. Need confirmation on blockers and an API key for POC. cc @anna_se @ryan_eng

anna_se: Quick Q — Dedicated or Private for the POC? The call sounded like Dedicated with peering but want to confirm.

ryan_eng: If Dedicated + VPC peering that's fine. We can stream audit events out from the control plane to a customer HEC endpoint or push to an S3 bucket. Customer needs to permit outbound to their HEC FQDN or provide an S3 bucket + assume-role.

maria_cs: FinFlow explicitly said Splunk HEC only. No S3 copies. They also asked if we can provide a short-lived API key scoped to POC usage and sample log schema. Pricing note: they asked for a trial discount (approx $30k/mo estimate).

infra_ops: We can create a scoped API key `poc-finflow-XXXX` with limited privileges. Important: our runtime emits `request_id` in control-plane audit events, not inline in every debug log by default — we can enable structured audit events (`audit.event_type`, `request_id`, `principal`, `resource`). Also note network egress from the private control plane -> customer HEC must be allowed.

security_bot: Security checklist: 1) redact PII from debug/log payloads before forwarding; 2) KMS wrapping for S3 exports (if used) and HEC TLS cert verification; 3) ensure no secret tokens are emitted in logs. For external HEC we need a signed data flow diagram in the questionnaire.

ryan_eng: Action items: 1) @anna_se confirm Dedicated + region; 2) @infra_ops create scoped API key and enable audit export; 3) @security_engine review redaction config and approve; 4) provide HEC ingest example and expected event schema to FinFlow.

anna_se: Confirmed Dedicated. FinFlow accepted peering to us-west-2. Please provision `poc-finflow-dedicated` pool with `audit:export=enabled` and routing policy -> primary us-west-2.

infra_ops: Ok starting provisioning now. ETA ~2h. Will deploy a log-forwarder job to push structured events to their HEC. Example curl for HEC ingest (for FinFlow):
```bash
curl -k https://splunk-finflow.example.com:8088/services/collector \
  -H 'Authorization: Splunk <HEC_TOKEN>' \
  -d '{"time":1680000000,"event":{"type":"audit","request_id":"req_123","actor":"user@example.com","action":"invoke_model","model":"gpt-redwood-3b"}}'
```

sam_sales: Also need a short blurb for the security questionnaire: "Are audit logs configurable/exportable?" Suggested answer: "Yes — audit events can be exported to customer-managed endpoints (S3/HEC). Exports support KMS wrapping and a redaction pipeline; retention is configurable (POC default: 90 days, enterprise up to 7 years)." Can someone make that official?

maria_cs: I'll prepare the sec-qa blurb and include links to SOC2 artifacts and our retention policy doc. Will attach sample event schema and a template assume-role policy for S3 if they change their mind.

security_engine: I'll review and sign off on the redaction rules. For KMS: customer can either provide a KMS key ARN and cross-account access, or we can use our envelope encryption for the POC. For production, recommend customer-provided CMK.

anna_se: Pricing update — sales ops approved 50% off on Dedicated for the first 3 months for POC. I've flagged this in the SOW draft.

infra_ops: Provisioning complete. Created API key id: `poc-finflow-1876543210` (scoped to telemetry + inference read for POC). Deployed forwarder `logging-forwarder-finflow` in `us-west-2`. Forwarder is successfully sending events to their HEC. Sample received event: {"time":1680000000,"event":"inference.request","request_id":"req_abc123","model":"gpt-redwood-3b","latency_ms":123} :white_check_mark:

sam_sales: Perfect — I'll send kickoff email with pricing, API key id, HEC example, and the security blurb. Thanks everyone :rocket:
